faq.q: Which public schools are on or at the foot of Sumas Mountain?
faq.a: Auguston Traditional Elementary, Mountain Elementary, Irene Kelleher Totí:ltawtxw Elementary and Sandy Hill Elementary are on the slopes, and Clayburn Middle is at the northwest foot; confirm a home's catchment school with the SD34 School Locator.

faq.q: Is there one school catchment for Sumas Mountain?
faq.a: No — locator runs split the mountain: 36367 Stephen Leacock Drive returns Auguston Traditional Elementary → Clayburn Middle → Robert Bateman Secondary, while 2540 Eagle Mountain Drive returns Irene Kelleher Totí:ltawtxw Elementary → William A. Fraser Middle → Yale Secondary (SD34 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01).

faq.q: What park and trails are on the mountain?
faq.a: Sumas Mountain Regional Park is an FVRD park at 39100 Sumas Mountain Forest Service Road, with the Chadsey Lake Trail to Chadsey Lake and hiking, trail running and mountain biking listed by the FVRD; park hours are 7 a.m. to sunset.

faq.q: Who plans land use on Sumas Mountain?
faq.a: Two plans apply: the City of Abbotsford Official Community Plan and McKee Neighbourhood Plan on the City side, and the FVRD Sumas Mountain Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 584, for the rural FVRD part.
